snippet.title: The Railroad Works for the Apple II
snippet.description:
Came also out for:

Commodore 64
DOS


Game description:

The Railroad Works allows you to construct your own model railroad. Using scenery and shipping/receiving sites, you can make simple and complex layouts. Once you have designed your layout, you can run one or two trains on the layout.

The game allows you to choose either steam or diesel engines and has five different types of rolling stock: boxcars, cattle cars, tank cars, passenger cars and a caboose.

More challenging tasks include moving cargo and people around between sites and keeping to a schedule.


What I think:

Nice construction game, where you can probably sit hours on constructing a railroad...that means if you are not as lazy as me. ;D

But the game is probably better if you use a mouse.
